# WAS_PoissonRegression { #wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression }

```python
WAS_PoissonRegression(nb_cores=1, dist_method='nonparam')
```

Poisson Regression model for spatiotemporal count-data prediction
(e.g. number of rainy days, dry spells, extreme event counts).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                | Description                                                                                                                          | Default     |
|-------------|---------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| nb_cores    | int                 | Number of CPU cores for parallel Dask computation.                                                                                   | `1`         |
| dist_method | (bestfit, nonparam) | Tercile probability method: - 'bestfit'  → parametric best-fit family per grid cell - 'nonparam' → empirical error-sample resampling | `'bestfit'` |

## Functions {.doc-section .doc-section-functions}

* **fit_predict**: Fit Poisson on one grid cell, return [error, prediction].
* **compute_model**: Parallel Poisson across the full spatial domain.
Returns xr.DataArray (Y, X) — deterministic prediction.
* **compute_prob**: Tercile probabilities for a deterministic hindcast.
* **forecast**: Predictor, hindcast_det, Predictor_for_year, ...)
End-to-end single-year forecast (deterministic + tercile proba).

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit](#wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit) | Tercile probabilities using best-fit climatological distribution family. |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric](#wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric) | Non-parametric tercile probabilities from historical error samples. |
| [compute_model](#wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.compute_model) | Parallel Poisson regression across the full (Y, X) domain. |
| [compute_prob](#wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.compute_prob) | Tercile probabilities for a deterministic hindcast. |
| [fit_predict](#wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.fit_predict) | Fit PoissonRegressor on one grid cell and return [error, prediction]. |
| [forecast](#wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.forecast) | End-to-end deterministic + tercile forecast for one target year. |
| [weibull_shape_solver](#wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.weibull_shape_solver) | Root function for Weibull shape parameter k given mean M and variance V. |

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit { #wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit }

```python
WAS_PoissonRegression.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit(
    best_guess,
    error_variance,
    T1,
    T2,
    dist_code,
    dof,
)
```

Tercile probabilities using best-fit climatological distribution family.

FIX 3 – Exponential (code 3): replaced undefined `loc_t` with `best_guess`
         (the forecast mean shifts the exponential location parameter).
FIX 4 – Weibull (code 5): replaced bare `weibull_shape_solver` (NameError)
         with `WAS_PoissonRegression.weibull_shape_solver` (static method ref).
FIX 5 – Weibull (code 5): removed debug print() statements.

### compute_model { #wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.compute_model }

```python
WAS_PoissonRegression.compute_model(X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test)
```

Parallel Poisson regression across the full (Y, X) domain.

FIX 3 – Dask client wrapped in try/finally so it closes even on error.
FIX 4 – X_test T=1 handling: isel(T=0) + expand_dims to avoid the
         bare .squeeze() stripping T dimension in CV folds.

### forecast { #wass2s.WAS_PoissonRegression.forecast }

```python
WAS_PoissonRegression.forecast(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    Predictor,
    hindcast_det,
    Predictor_for_year,
    best_code_da=None,
```
